2225-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

101-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1719-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1719-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

4490-7684--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7684--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7684--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

3967-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
3967-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

826-3899-6243-7747.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-6243-7747.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1267-2511-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2511-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

1733-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
1733-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Nephalia Smuggler by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2173-3025-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2585-3918-4851.notes: Once you have extra mana, Grim Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

5170-5231-6132-7452.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-6747-7101.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
141-6747-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3488-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-5231-7062.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Aang triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1256-5499-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-7060.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1558-6568-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.
1558-6568-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1170-1329-2198-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

681-4826-5412-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4826-5412-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2511-2577-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2511-2577-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

813-1567-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Momentary Blink.
813-1567-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

955-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
955-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5642-5657-5664.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability triggers twice, and Echoes of Eternity triggers once.
Resolve one of Writhing Chrysalis' triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, copying the Writhing Chrysalis spell.
Resolve the copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Writhing Chrysalis triggers twice for each Eldrazi sacrificed, putting a total of four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Resolve one of Ulalek's triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Writhing Chrysalis triggers twice for each Eldrazi sacrificed, putting a total of four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 7, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy each Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 8 any number of times.
End the combo by letting the stack resolve, putting an infinite number of Writhing Chrysalis tokens onto the battlefield.

891-2386-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

215-225-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-225-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant any number of times.

1988-2034-5086.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Triskelavus.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-2034-5086.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may instead use the Triskelavite token's ability to sacrifice it, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

224-1772-3257-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

944-1824-2661.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed nor are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
944-1824-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Acererak enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1223-3191-4050.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting Kairi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kairi, adding {B}.
Kairi dies, triggering its ability granted by Fake Your Own Death and its other ability.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the second Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Fake Your Own Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

751-2430-3415-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Shrieking Drake.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Shrieking Drake and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Shrieking Drake from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Shrieking Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

186-411-913-2146.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3510-4488-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
One other Creature in hand.
3510-4488-4875.description:
Cast the creature, triggering Rampaging Baeloths due to Life and Limb.
Create a token, triggering Baeloth.
Repeat
